sources.title: Anthropic Claude Duet proactive agent (Oct 21)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Research preview by waitlist, US Pro/Max subscribers first, sharing existing plan limits; background checks consume plan limits, larger tasks cost more turns. Rolling/waitlist status vendor-stated; per-plan rollout unvalidated.

Proactive agent on Opus 5.5: morning brief, monitors connected apps, scheduling/dashboard/forecast/web-app tasks, keeps working when away, checks before key actions. Behaviour vendor-described; independent repro absent.

Runs in VM with own browser; 6000+ Marketplace connectors (Gmail/Slack, QuickBooks/Stripe, Gusto, LinkedIn, Docusign, HubSpot, Canva, Shopify) is CATALOGUE count, NOT individually live inventory — live per-connector status unvalidated; Stripe Link virtual card + Shop Pay; 1Password sign-in coming soon (NOT live); securities trading + money movement off-limits even with approval.
claims.context: Marketplace + payment + 1Password sections; catalogue vs live distinguished per IA-011

claims.text: Safety stack: trustworthy-agents framework, Managed-Agents credential design (never sees passwords/tokens), auto-mode classifier approval, browser-use prompt-injection defences, red-team + external pen-test + bug bounty, dedicated CC/gov-ID blocking classifier. Vendor-described; behaviour unreproduced.
Work-first limits: personal errands weaker, cannot show browser yet; standalone app separate from main Claude app.

limitations.text: Independent behavioural reproduction absent; per-connector live status unvalidated; 6000+ != live
